dict.string: GYM AI uses the camera to detect your exercise posture in real time and count repetitions. Video is processed on-device and is not uploaded by default.
GYM AI can listen for voice commands such as Start workout, Next exercise, Pause workout, How many reps, and End workout. Touch controls always work as a fallback.
GYM AI sends workout reminders at your chosen gym time, a 30-minute warning, and rest-day messages.
GYM AI can read health data only if you enable it in the future. It is not required for workouts, food logging, or progress.
